lines.l: This isn't love, but it's something more
Citrus hair, secret stripe on the vine
He stole the moment like he knew it was mine
Locals said the beautiful lie best
And I believed him in Italian
He held my waist like a cigarette
Licked me out before I could land
Fever in Capri, sweat on my skin, lip stain and sin
Dripping in Dior, but I taste like ill
He kissed me like a dare, then vanished in the steam
Now I breathe out his name like a midsummer dream
Fever in Capri, he never really wanted me
Gold chain tangled on the nightstand
His cologne on my throat like a bread
Balcony winds under in my chest
I danced alone in my black slip dress
Locals warm don't fall for the ghost
But I was fluent in pretend
He said forever like a passing toast
And left before the bitter end
Fever in Capri
Drunk on a promise, curled in silk
Woke up sore
Sun burnt and built
To miss him like a vice
Still chasing the dream
Now I swear down his name
Like we're both in a heat wave
Fever in Capri
He never really wanted me
He said, don't call it love, just call it sweet
I wore that line like perfume in the heat
Not every man tastes like deja vu
And none of them ever quite do
Fever in Capri, burning where he used to be
A love that dressed like mystery
He kissed me like a dare, then vanished in the steam
Now I breathe out his name like a Midsummer dream
Fever it could breathe
He never really wanted me
